summary: SPX hit a fresh ATH (7757.64) and the tape ran risk-on after July payrolls unexpectedly fell 23k, crushing yields and lifting rate-cut odds. Software earnings blew out (TEAM +35%, TWLO +25%, DOCS +33%) even as TTD -22% split the group; semis rebounded (XSD +4.66%). Smart Money surged into gold and hard assets (GDX +7.11%). NDX still reads Bearish/Elevated despite +1.19% — a regime-vs-price divergence to watch.
